simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to אָבַךְ (H55) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: v.
simple.whyItMatters: This word is connected to the original Hebrew source text, so BibleIQ can explain it from the underlying word rather than only the English translation.
simple.summary: אָבַךְ (ʼâbak) means probably to coil upward First listed occurrence: Isa 9 17.

definitions.full: H55. abak [ אָבַךְ ] verb turn (?) (compare Assyrian Abâku Dl w = הָפַךְ ; Thes MV and others compare בוך ) Hithpa`el וַיִּתְאַבְכוּ Isa 9:17 ; roll, roll up , as volume of smoke (of Israel under figure of thickets of forest) see De & compare הִתִהַמֵּךְ Judg 7:3 .
